subject: DPA / SCCs for VelaCare MSA & Order Form - redlines and execution lane
messages:
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@velacare.com>
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: carlos.reyes@velacare.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 08:34:00 -0700
Subject: DPA & SCCs — initial redlines attached

Hi Priyom,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and legal reviewed the MSA + order form and have a few data-transfer concerns that they want reflected in the DPA before we move to signature. I attached our proposed DPA redline (VelaCare_DPA_Redline_20260917.docx).

Key asks from our side:
- Add explicit KMS/HSM controls for customer-managed keys or an equivalent key separation mechanism.
- Carveout for clinical data residency in US-only regions (we operate in CA + AZ).
- Stronger subprocessor approval rights and a 30-day notice before onboarding any new subprocessor.
- For SCCs, VelaCare needs a clause guaranteeing at-rest encryption in EU transfers and a list of subprocessors with locations.

Can you confirm which of these items Redwood can accept as-is, which require a tech workaround, and which need escalation to legal? Also please share SOC2 evidence (if available) and a target timeline for a final DPA.

Best,
Emily
Emily Zhang
Head of Procurement — VelaCare

From: priyom_das@redwood.com
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@velacare.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: DPA & SCCs — initial redlines attached

Emily — thanks for the clear summary and the redline. Forwarding to Laura (legal) and Karthik (privacy / product) to scope the asks. Quick ⬇️ from my side:

- KMS: we support customer-managed keys in Private deployments; for Hosted we offer provider-managed keys with BYOK roadmap discussions. Need legal on exact wording the customer needs.
- Subprocessors: Marketplace + critical infra list we can provide; 30-day notice is doable for major infra/subs, smaller service suppliers typically have 14-day notice in our standard DPA — flagging for legal.
- Residency carveouts: we can propose an order-form specific exhibit that pins region routing; product needs to confirm any throughput/latency impacts for dedicated pools.

Laura / Karthik, could you review Emily's doc and propose line-by-line responses and any redline back to VelaCare? Prefer to keep changes to order-form/exhibits where possible rather than change base MSA.

Action items I see:
1) Legal redline response (Laura) — by EOD Monday (20 Sep)
2) Product feasibility note (Karthik) — by EOD Monday
3) Provide SOC2 & subprocessor list (Priyom) — attached SOC2 PDF (sensitive) and spreadsheet link to follow

Emily, I'll attach SOC2 and a first-pass subprocessor list in my next email. If helpful, we can do a 30-minute sync on Monday after Laura's response.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: priyom_das@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: DPA & SCCs — initial redlines attached

Priyom / team — reviewed VelaCare_DPA_Redline_20260917.docx and summarized below. I am including proposed compromise language (high level) we can send as a tracked redline.

Line-item summary / proposed positions:
1) KMS/HSM
- VelaCare ask: explicit customer-managed KMS for Hosted API.
- Our position: Hosted API uses provider-managed keys; we can offer BYOK for Dedicated or Private. Proposed text: "Customer may request BYOK for Dedicated or Private deployments; for Hosted API Redwood will implement key separation controls and provide KMS diagram/evidence."
- Escalation: if customer requires BYOK on Hosted, commercial uplift + engineering review required.

2) Data residency carveout
- VelaCare ask: US-only residency for clinical data.
- Our position: Add an Order Form Exhibit (Exhibit D — Data Routing) that maps customer routes to US regions only for specific data classifications. Include SLO notes.
- Product impact: potential capacity/latency implications; need to quantify.

3) Subprocessors / notice period
- VelaCare ask: 30-day notice and opt-out for new subprocessors.
- Our position: 30-day notice for material subprocessors; 14-day for non-material. We can include an Escalation Right: for new material subprocessor, customer may request a security questionnaire and temporary mitigation until evidence provided.

4) SCCs / EU transfers & encryption at rest
- VelaCare ask: explicit language on encryption in EU transfers and subprocessor locations.
- Our position: confirm encryption at rest for all customer data; attach subprocessor registry and incorporate SCCs as part of DPA. Propose to provide region-by-region subprocessor table as an annex.

Requested redline timeline: I will produce a tracked redline and cover note by EOD Tue 21 Sep. Priyom, please confirm if we want to 1) send the tracked redline + cover note to Emily directly or 2) schedule the Monday sync (you suggested) for a walkthrough first.

References/attachments: SOC2 Type II (redacted) is attached internally; I'll include a customer-facing SOC2 summary and the subprocessor registry in the Google Drive link provided.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
